video.decoding_capability: AI Off: 2CH at 16MP, 4CH at 8MP, 8CH at 4MP, 16CH at 1080p (30 fps); AI On: 1CH at 16MP, 3CH at 8MP, 5CH at 4MP, 8CH at 1080p (30 fps)

features: Maximum PoE output per port: 25.5 W
Analytics by Recorder (limited channels): iMD NVR 4CH, VCA NVR 2CH, Face Detection NVR 8CH, Face Capture and Recognition 1CH
Analytics by Camera: iMD 8CH, VCA 8CH, Face Detection 8CH, Face Picture Comparison Alarm 8CH
License Plate Recognition 8CH (LPR camera required), 2 block lists, 2 allow lists, up to 20,000 plates
Up to 10 face picture libraries (max. 20,000 pictures)
notes: Datasheet gives power consumption as < 10 W, HDD not included.
Datasheet recording resolutions go up to 16MP, while the datasheet feature comparison table gives maximum camera resolution as 'Up to 4K'. Maximum camera resolution left out.
Product page lists maximum internal storage as 20TB, while the product page description states 16TB HDD x2 for 32TB total.
Bandwidth values are for AI Off. With AI On the datasheet gives 180 Mbps incoming and outgoing.
